sentiment_evidence: Perfect, that's exactly my list. Thank you so much Riya.

issues.title: Thank-you page redirect
issues.problem_statement: After checkout, customers landed on the default page instead of the customer's own thank-you page.

issues.title: Mobile landing page buttons overlap
issues.problem_statement: On the customer's phone, the two buttons on their landing page overlapped each other.

issues.title: Emails going to spam / email domain verification
issues.problem_statement: The customer's emails were going to spam and they had read that they need to verify their email domain.

issues.title: Expired EARLYBIRD coupon
issues.problem_statement: The customer's EARLYBIRD coupon has expired and they are not sure whether they want to extend it.

issues.title: Invoice GST name
issues.problem_statement: The GST name on the customer's invoices shows their personal name instead of their company name.

issues.title: Weekly lesson unlock (drip) for a course sold in a bundle
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants the lessons of their course to unlock one per week for their students; the course is sold inside a bundle.

issues.title: AI quiz generator availability
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked whether FlexiFunnels has an AI quiz generator, as a friend had said it does.

issues.title: Exporting the student list
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked how to export their student list.

items.description: Customer pasted their thank-you page link into the empty redirect field in the product's After purchase settings, saved it, and confirmed that a test order now goes to their thank-you page, following support's guidance.
evidence: Pasted and saved. Let me do a test order... yes, it now goes to my thank-you page.
I see the redirect field is empty.

items.description: Customer increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view of the page editor and confirmed on their phone that the buttons are now separate, following support's guidance.
evidence: yes, now they are separate, it looks fine.

items.description: Support explained that to verify the email domain, the customer adds their domain in Email settings, receives three DNS records, adds those three records at their domain registrar, and then clicks Verify in the email settings.
evidence: add your domain and you will get three DNS records.
Once the records are added, click Verify in the email settings.

items.description: Customer will get their developer, who has the registrar login, to add the three DNS records at the domain registrar.
evidence: My developer has it. I'll get him to add the records by Friday.

items.description: Support explained that the expiry date of the coupon can be changed in the coupon settings if the customer decides to extend it; the customer has not decided and said they will think about it.
evidence: If you decide to extend it, you can change the expiry date in the coupon settings.

items.description: Support will check about changing the GST name on the customer's invoices and get back to the customer.
evidence: I'll check with our billing team about changing it, and get back to you within 2 working days.

items.description: Support said there is a drip schedule setting for lessons, but that support is not sure whether it works when the course is sold inside a bundle, which is how the customer sells it.
evidence: There is a drip schedule setting for lessons.
I'm not sure whether it works when the course is sold inside a bundle

items.description: Support will check whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle and get back to the customer.
evidence: Let me check that with our product team and get back to you.

items.description: Support said it is not aware of an AI quiz generator being available right now, has no date for one, and advised the customer not to plan around it.
evidence: I'm not aware of a quiz generator being available right now, and I don't have a date for one.
So please don't plan around it.

items.description: Support explained that the student list can be exported by going to Students, clicking Export and choosing CSV, which downloads a file that can be opened in a spreadsheet.
evidence: Go to Students, click Export, and choose CSV.

items.description: Customer said they will try exporting their student list later.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
